title: decree-go-rest.yml
description: The config of decree-go-rest, the HTTP front door of a decree 0.5 project (SPEC.md §3). Every key is optional except `endpoints`, each endpoint's `path`, an emit endpoint's `message.machine`, an event endpoint's `reply.to` and `reply.event`, and a resolvable secret. This schema checks the shape; `decree-go-rest -check` checks the rest: that paths do not conflict, patterns compile, placeholders are path parameters, machines and their data exist, secrets are set, and decree runs. GET /openapi.json is switched by the environment variable DECREE_GO_REST_OPENAPI, not by this file.

project.description: The directory that holds .decree/, relative to this file. By default this file's directory, or its parent when this file is in .decree/.

listen.description: The address to listen on, host:port. Keep it on localhost behind a TLS reverse proxy. Overridden by DECREE_GO_REST_LISTEN when that is set. Takes effect only on restart.

secret_env.description: The environment variable holding the default bearer secret, at least 32 characters (generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`). Secrets never appear in this file, so it can be committed.

decree.description: The decree binary (0.5 or newer): a name on PATH or a path.

daemon.description: The supervised `decree daemon` (SPEC.md §5). Takes effect only on restart.

enabled.description: Supervise `decree daemon` in the project: start it before listening, restart it with back-off when it exits, and stop it on shutdown. The environment variable DECREE_GO_REST_DAEMON overrides it; the container image sets it to false.

interval.description: Passed to the daemon as --interval: how often it processes the project.

limits.description: The request body cap and the two global rate budgets (SPEC.md §6).

max_body_bytes.description: The largest request body, in bytes. A larger one is a 413.

rate_window.description: The length of the fixed window both rate budgets are counted in.

rate_max.description: Authenticated requests per window, all endpoints together. When spent: 429 with Retry-After.

rate_fail_max.description: Rejected requests per window (bad auth, unknown path, wrong method). When spent, they get 429; authenticated requests are unaffected.

endpoints.description: The endpoints: each turns an authenticated POST into a decree message, written by `decree emit` (action: emit), or into a reply to a run waiting in a person state, sent by `decree event` (action: event).

duration.description: decree's duration format: a positive whole number and s, m, h or d.

envName.description: The name of an environment variable.

endpoint.description: One endpoint: POST <path> emits a message for one machine (action: emit, the default, with `message`), or replies to a run waiting in a person state (action: event, with `reply`).

path.description: `/` followed by literal segments and `{name}` segments, one full segment per parameter (`\w+`). No `..`, no empty segments, and neither /healthz nor /openapi.json, nor a path under them: both are reserved. One trailing slash on a request is ignored.

action.description: `emit` (the default) queues a new message with `decree emit`, and requires `message`. `event` replies to a run waiting in a person state with `decree event`, and requires `reply`. Neither takes the other's key.

secret_env.description: The environment variable holding this endpoint's own secret, instead of the top-level `secret_env`. Give an endpoint that reaches a powerful machine its own.

patterns.description: A Go RE2 regular expression per path parameter, anchored automatically, replacing the default: `[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}` for a parameter an event endpoint uses in `reply.to` (wait ids contain dots), `[A-Za-z0-9_\-!]+` for any other. A parameter that does not fully match is a 400, never repaired.

body.description: `required` (the default for emit): a blank body is a 400. `optional` (the default for event): an empty body is allowed. `none`: any body is a 400. An emit endpoint's body reaches decree on stdin, as the message body; an event endpoint's is the note, passed unchanged as `-m=<body>`.

message.description: The message an emit endpoint queues. Not allowed with action: event.

machine.description: The decree machine, `.decree/machines/<name>.yml` in the project. Fixed: a placeholder is not allowed here.

params.description: Values for the machine's `data`, passed to `decree emit` as --param in the order listed. Each key must be in the machine's data and each literal match its type. A string may hold `{{name}}` placeholders for path parameters, which require string data; every path parameter must be used.

reply.description: The reply an event endpoint sends: `decree event <to> <event> [-m=<note>] --format json`, with the body as the note. Not allowed with action: emit. Every path parameter must be used in `to` or `event`.

to.description: The wait id of the run waiting in a person state, usually a placeholder such as '{{wait_id}}'.

event.description: The event the run takes. A literal must match decree's event-name pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z0-9_]+)*$`; it may instead hold a `{{name}}` placeholder.
